modules.label: Parse Uptime Table
modules.note: Markdown table → CSV-style cells → JSON rows (no raw markdown to LLM).
modules.inputDescription: ParsedTable parsed from the vendor SLA uptime report markdown table

fallbackList.typescript: const splitMdRow=(r)=>r.slice(1,-1).split("|").map(c=>c.trim());const mdTableToRows=(body)=>{const t=[];const lines=body.split("\n");let i=0,ti=0;while(i<lines.length){const line=lines[i].trim();if(!line.startsWith("|")||!line.endsWith("|")){i++;continue;}const block=[];while(i<lines.length){const l=lines[i].trim();if(!l.startsWith("|")||!l.endsWith("|"))break;block.push(l);i++;}if(block.length<2)continue;const headers=splitMdRow(block[0]);const data=block.slice(2).filter(l=>!/^[|][\s\-:|]+[|]$/.test(l));t.push({name:"table_"+ ++ti,rows:data.map(ln=>{const c=splitMdRow(ln);const o={};headers.forEach((h,j)=>o[h]=c[j]??"");return o;})});}return t;};const mdFirstTableRows=(body)=>(mdTableToRows(body)[0]?.rows??[]);(doc)=>({rows_json:JSON.stringify(mdFirstTableRows(doc.content)),row_count:mdFirstTableRows(doc.content).length})
